platform: macOS aarch64 local JVM black-box fixture
trigger: an unrelated business method calls ObjectMapper.readValue for java.lang.String while another controller endpoint binds a changed DTO
actual_pre_fix_behavior: the semantic overlay attached the unrelated ObjectMapper caller as an exact caller of every DTO owner already present in the binding map
expected_behavior: the unrelated caller has no lib.Dto descriptor or bytecode evidence and must not receive an implicit_data_contract_dispatch edge to lib.Dto.removed
root_cause: a direct ObjectMapper or EntityManager call was globally copied into every existing binding-owner bucket without recovering a target type
reproduction: Compile a controller endpoint whose descriptor binds lib.Dto and a separate method that deserializes only java.lang.String.
Use javap -c -s to prove the separate method contains the ObjectMapper call but no lib.Dto reference.
Run the public binary pipeline and reject any implicit DTO edge whose caller is the unrelated method.
